tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience with Central Government or State Government or PSU/ Private Clients The Bidder should have experience of providing Manpower Services for at least 5 (Five) State Government or State PSU/ Private clients in the last 5 years (i.e since 01 JAN 2021 onwards).(Mini manpower supply of 60 Numbers)

Average Annual Turnover The Bidder should have had an average annual turnover of at least INR 1 Crore (Rupees One Crore only) for the last 5 (Five) completed financial years (FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26)The Financial Capacity of the parent / subsidiary / associate entities of the Bidder would not be considered for assessment of eligibility
